title: Sworn Building Amount Behind a Building Payment — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
Claims payment rule for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): the sworn building amount a building payment is measured against, read from every building proof of loss filed for the date of loss, including those under a duplicate claim number for that date.

**Rule.** The sworn building amount a building payment is measured against is settled as follows: when the latest building proof of loss for the date of loss was received after the proof-of-loss period, counted by adding the days to the date of loss on the calendar, the amounts sworn on the other building proofs of loss for the date of loss are added together and the late one is left out; when more than one building proof of loss was filed for the date of loss and the latest was received within that period, the amounts sworn on all of them are added together, each later proof of loss claiming an additional amount; otherwise it is the amount sworn on the latest building proof of loss for the date of loss.

The proof-of-loss period is 60 calendar days after the date of loss on every tier; a receipt on day 60 is within it, a receipt on day 61 is after it.

## Ladder

| Building proofs of loss for the date of loss | Sworn building amount |
|---|---|
| Latest received after day 60 | the total of the other proofs of loss, the late one left out |
| More than one, latest received by day 60 | the total of all of them |
| Exactly one, received by day 60 | the amount on that proof of loss |

## Cases (hypothetical; date of loss 1 August)

- Proofs of loss of 60,000.00 (received 25 August) and 12,000.00 (received 30 September, day 60): 72,000.00.
- Proofs of loss of 60,000.00 (25 August) and 12,000.00 (1 October, day 61): 60,000.00 — the late one is left out.
- One proof of loss of 60,000.00 received 25 August: 60,000.00.
